clusters.headline: Ethiopia and Tigray accuse each of launching offensives, fuelling fears of new war
clusters.summary: The local authorities reportedly seize Tigray's airports following reports of recent drone strikes.

clusters.headline: Eleven killed in mass shooting at house in South Africa
clusters.summary: One of those killed is believed to be a pregnant woman, police said.

clusters.headline: Famine threatens the Ukrainian town of Oleshky in the southern Kherson region as Russia delays creating a humanitarian evacuation corridor
clusters.summary: Food supplies to the town of Oleshky in the occupied part of the southern Kherson region have been cut off since May. Efforts by Kyiv to negotiate the evacuation of civilians with Moscow have been largely unsuccessful.

clusters.headline: Africa: Vaccination Rates Are Falling in Africa, but a New Strategy Aims to Turn Things Around. Five Things It Needs to Get Right
clusters.summary: [The Conversation Africa] Africa has reached an important moment in its immunisation journey. Coverage is not rising fast enough to keep pace with population growth, persistent inequities and a growing number of vaccines. At the same time, outbreaks and financing pressures are intensifying.

clusters.headline: Slovakia: PM Robert Fico's NATO Article 5 remarks spark criticism and raise questions about his country's NATO commitment
clusters.summary: Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico says he fears war and will do everything he can to keep his country out of one. Critics say his remarks risk weakening NATO, the alliance that was designed to prevent such a war.

clusters.headline: Man fails to prove money from then-girlfriend was given out of ‘love and affection’, ordered to repay S$321,000
clusters.summary: The High Court ordered a man to repay his former girlfriend more than S$320,000, finding that he was not a “credible witness”.

clusters.headline: Pakistan's jailed former PM Khan's sons told DW the authorities are cracking down ahead of new PTI protests
clusters.summary: The sons of jailed Pakistani ex-PM Imran Khan told DW their father is in ill health while being isolated from family and doctors. Other relatives have been detained ahead of a planned opposition protest.

clusters.headline: US judge blocks Trump ban of CNN, MS NOW, Politico from White House, orders him to restore access
clusters.summary: A judge has ordered President Trump to restore White House access to CNN, MS NOW and Politico after he banned the media outlets from the premises.

clusters.headline: New fighting in Ethiopia's Tigray region raises fears of a return to the country's civil war
clusters.summary: Fighting in and around Tigray is testing Ethiopia's fragile 2022 peace deal. With old enemies forming new alliances, experts warn that the conflict could enter a dangerous new phase.

clusters.headline: Poland says fire at Starlink station is sabotage as Denmark warns of rising Russian threat
clusters.summary: The satellite station is used in part to provide internet coverage to neighbouring Ukraine, the government says.
